versions.content: DET error reporting of ETHIF_E_INV_CLKUNIT_IDX The EthIf APIs which has the parameter ClkUnitIdx shall check the parameter ClkUnitIdx for being valid. If the check fails, the function shall raise the develop- ment error ETHIF_E_INV_CLKUNIT_IDX when the development error detection is enabled.
